artifact_inventory.description: Deterministic NumPy verification of the inverse-positive closed form, the expected energy identity, and the Dirichlet-Poisson specialization.
Verified deterministic output of the numerical checks.

limitations: Exact arithmetic, exact single-coordinate minimization, fixed iid sampling and the worst-case expected A-energy/objective-gap factor only. The result does not optimize adaptive, without-replacement, block, accelerated, greedy, spectral or conjugate-direction policies. Computing the distribution for a generic matrix requires a linear solve, so the theorem is structural unless that solve is reusable or available from problem structure. The inverse-positive condition is sufficient, not asserted necessary. Broad optimal-design and diagonal-scaling literatures leave residual historical-equivalence risk.
record_title: Closed-form optimal coordinate sampling for inverse-positive SPD quadratics
scientific_context: For exact randomized coordinate descent on an SPD quadratic, the sharp fixed-sampling A-energy contraction parameter is the smallest eigenvalue of P^{1/2} C P^{1/2}, where C is the unit-diagonal normalized Hessian. If A^{-1} is entrywise nonnegative, the unique optimal fixed iid sampling is p proportional to C^{-1}1 and the optimum is 1/(1^T C^{-1}1).
